name: Ohio Checkbook, local governments
note: 37 participating fire agencies. Fire districts: whole checkbook. Townships, cities and villages: only lines whose fund or department is named for fire; fire spending they book under general 'Public Safety' lines is not included. Participation is voluntary and uploads lag by entity (latest payment 2026-08-31); FY2026 partial

name: City of Cincinnati Vendor Payments
note: Cincinnati Fire Department only (department codes 224, 271, 272). Not included: fire apparatus and ambulances, which the City buys through its citywide vehicle account 981 (FY2021-FY2027: $18.7 million), and other purchases city departments make for Fire (fleet repairs, IT); P-card spend is paid to the card banks, so those merchants are not shown; FY2027 partial (payments through 2026-10-02)
